needs.description: Complete adult dry kibble formulated for medium-activity, 50 lb adult dogs. 15–30 lb bag size, balanced protein/fat for maintenance, labeled explicitly 'chicken-free' (uses beef, fish, lamb, or novel protein). Moderate kibble size for medium jaws; suitable for daily feeding.
needs.rationale: Daily food is a consumable used every day — must be chicken-free because this Shar Pei has a documented chicken allergy. Providing an appropriate adult formula meets caloric needs for a medium-activity 50 lb dog and prevents accidental exposure.

needs.family: Filtered stainless-steel pet water fountain (2+ L capacity)
needs.description: Countertop/floor automatic circulating water fountain with replaceable charcoal filter, 2–3 liter capacity, stainless steel bowl, quiet pump. Size appropriate for one medium dog in an apartment; promotes frequent drinking.
needs.rationale: Fresh, circulated water encourages hydration every day. With current excessive heat warnings, increased hydration is urgent to reduce heat stress; fountain improves water appeal and reduces heat-related risk.

needs.family: Portable dog water bottle with integrated collapsible bowl (large capacity ~700–1000 ml)
needs.description: Handheld, leak-proof bottle with attached silicone collapsible bowl or flip-down drinking tray, capacity ~700–1000 ml, easy one-handed use, dishwasher-safe parts, medium/large sizing for 50 lb dog.
needs.rationale: Apartment with no yard requires walks; during an excessive-heat period the dog needs accessible water on outings to prevent overheating and dehydration. This is immediate safety for outdoor times.

needs.family: Self-cooling mat (large, durable for medium dogs)
needs.description: Pressure-activated or gel-based self-cooling mat sized for a 50 lb dog (approx. 30–36" long), non-toxic, puncture-resistant surface, non-slip base — no refrigeration required for passive cooling.
needs.rationale: Current excessive heat warning creates immediate risk of overheating in an apartment without yard access. A self-cooling mat provides a safe, passive cooling surface indoors right now.

needs.description: Durable, leak-resistant waste bags in bulk (rolls or box), dispenser-ready, 200+ count, medium/large size to handle 50 lb dog's waste on daily walks.
needs.rationale: Daily waste pickup on walks is a daily consumable necessity for apartment living without a yard — required every outing and therefore essential now.

needs.family: High-visibility LED collar or rechargeable LED safety vest (medium)
needs.description: Rechargeable LED collar or lighted harness/vest with multiple flash modes, adjustable for medium dogs (neck circumference appropriate for 50 lb), USB-charged, water-resistant, includes reflective strips.
needs.rationale: Hunting season and changing daylight (Daylight Saving End upcoming) increase risk of reduced visibility. For apartment-dwelling dogs who walk near roads/trails, a lighted collar/vest is immediate safety to avoid accidents.

needs.description: Single-use or pack wipes formulated for facial/skin folds: pH-balanced, gentle antiseptic (chlorhexidine or similar-safe alternative), fragrance-free, 50–100 count. Soft cloth size for deep facial folds.
needs.rationale: Shar Peis have prominent skin folds that trap moisture and debris, increasing infection risk — routine fold cleaning is a veterinary best practice to prevent dermatitis. Useful now during seasonal allergens and humidity changes.

needs.description: Mild, moisturizing shampoo formulated for sensitive or allergy-prone skin, free of chicken-derived ingredients and heavy fragrances, 12–16 oz bottle, suitable for monthly or as-needed baths.
needs.rationale: Fall allergy season and breed sensitivity can exacerbate skin irritation; a gentle hypoallergenic shampoo helps reduce itch and soothe skin without introducing chicken-based proteins in topical products.

needs.description: Gentle ear cleanser for dogs prone to otitis: alcohol-free, pH-balanced, 4–8 oz bottle with easy applicator or wipes. Suitable for routine maintenance of floppy or close-set ears.
needs.rationale: Shar Peis can be predisposed to ear problems; routine ear cleaning reduces infection risk and aligns with preventive grooming practices.

needs.description: Breed/size-appropriate dental chews or enzymatic daily dental treats sized for a 50 lb dog; designed to reduce plaque/tartar with chewing action, labeled non-chicken ingredients.
needs.rationale: Veterinary best practice recommends routine dental maintenance; daily chews reduce plaque buildup and complement brushing, lowering future dental disease risk.

needs.family: HEPA air purifier sized for apartment (pet/allergen filter)
needs.description: Portable HEPA air purifier rated for medium rooms (e.g., up to ~600 sq ft), with activated carbon and pet-specific prefilter to reduce dander, pollen and indoor allergens.
needs.rationale: Fall allergy season (through 10/31) and an apartment setting make indoor air quality important for both pet comfort and reducing skin/respiratory allergen load.

needs.description: Plug-in pheromone diffuser designed for dogs (coverage ~400–700 sq ft) that releases calming pheromones continuously; replaceable refill cartridges.
needs.rationale: Leaf blower season, hunting season, and upcoming Halloween door activity can cause situational anxiety; a pheromone diffuser helps reduce stress indoors without medication.

needs.description: Adjustable anxiety wrap designed to apply gentle, even pressure across the torso (size medium/large for 50 lb), machine-washable fabric, breathable material for indoor use.
needs.rationale: Noise events (leaf blowers, hunting, Halloween) and schedule changes (school calendar) can cause stress; an anxiety wrap is a non-pharmaceutical option to reduce acute anxiety during triggers.

needs.description: Orthopedic memory-foam bed or elevated cot sized for a 50 lb dog (approx. 30–36" length), removable washable cover, bolstered edges optional for head support.
needs.rationale: Supports joint health and provides comfortable rest in an apartment setting; proactive comfort reduces stress on joints as the dog ages and improves quality of sleep.

needs.description: Cordless nail grinder with variable speeds, LED light, and safety guard; suitable for medium-sized dog nails and apartment grooming to avoid loud clipping noise.
needs.rationale: Regular nail maintenance prevents overgrowth, splitting and discomfort. A grinder is quieter and more controllable for apartment use and dogs sensitive to clippers.

needs.description: Soft, small training treats using non-chicken protein (fish, duck, beef, lamb, or plant-based), bite-sized for frequent rewards during short apartment sessions; pack of several hundred.
needs.rationale: Positive reinforcement training and daily interactions support behavior and mental engagement. Avoiding chicken prevents allergic reactions.

needs.description: Durable hollow rubber toy that dispenses kibble/treats when rolled or manipulated; medium-large size for a 50 lb dog, puncture-resistant material for average chewers.
needs.rationale: Provides mental stimulation and slows feeding; valuable in an apartment with no yard to keep the dog engaged and reduce boredom-related behavior.

needs.description: Fabric snuffle mat sized for medium dogs where kibble/treats can be hidden to encourage nose work and slow feeding; machine-washable.
needs.rationale: Encourages natural foraging instincts and offers low-impact mental exercise indoors, especially useful during upcoming rainy days or when outside time is limited.

needs.description: Plastic or silicone slow-feeder bowl with maze pattern or multi-chamber puzzle bowl sized for adult meal portions to prolong feeding time and provide enrichment.
needs.rationale: Slows rapid eating, adds mental stimulation at meal times, suitable for daily use in an apartment environment.

needs.family: Durable chew toy (rubber/nylon) for average chewers
needs.description: Durable chew (rubber or tough nylon) sized for medium dogs, shaped to encourage chewing without small pieces; medium density for average chewers—helps with oral stimulation.
needs.rationale: Satisfies chewing needs and redirects destructive chewing; appropriate durability given the dog's average chew strength.

needs.description: Soft, indoor-safe ball for apartment fetch; non-abrasive, quiet on floors, medium size appropriate for a 50 lb dog, washable.
needs.rationale: Allows safe indoor play when weather limits outside time; helps maintain activity level without damaging apartment surfaces or causing noise complaints.

needs.description: Medium-duty braided rope with comfortable handles sized for interactive tug games between owner and dog; not intended for unsupervised chewing.
needs.rationale: Interactive play (tug) builds bonding and provides physical exercise in limited-space living conditions.
evidence: pet_profile: about: Very loving, friendly and quite.

needs.description: Starter kit with sample scent containers or hide-and-seek scent toys and simple instructions to teach nose games; compact for apartment use.
needs.rationale: Nose work is highly stimulating and low-impact — ideal for keeping a medium-activity dog mentally satisfied indoors or on short walks.

needs.family: Lightweight waterproof raincoat with reflective trim (medium)
needs.description: Packable, breathable waterproof raincoat with belly coverage and reflective strips sized for a 50 lb medium dog; easy-on fasteners for quick walks.
needs.rationale: Rain season and apartment living mean more walks in wet weather; a raincoat keeps the dog comfortable, reduces indoor mess, and encourages continued outdoor exercise.

needs.family: Paw cleaning kit or absorbent doormat (for wet paws)
needs.description: Portable paw wipes (pet-safe saline or mild cleanser) or an absorbent paw-cleaning mat sized for medium dogs to remove mud/water after rainy walks.
needs.rationale: Helps keep the apartment clean during rainy season and reduces skin fold moisture transfer from dirty/wet paws — convenience and hygiene improvement.

needs.description: Lightweight fabric bandana that can be soaked and wrung to provide evaporative cooling; size adjustable for medium dogs, machine-washable.
needs.rationale: Supplemental cooling for short outdoor excursions during heat waves; complements the cooling mat and portable water to reduce heat discomfort.
